subject: VP/CTO alignment + proposed tech deep-dive slots
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@orbitai.com>, Samir Rao <samir@orbitai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: VP/CTO alignment + proposed tech deep-dive slots

Hi Jill / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the clear outline of OrbitAI's latency sensitivity for inference and the throughput targets you shared. Quick recap + next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

- Discovery recap: primary use-case is real-time summarization in the operator console; target p95 latency < 220ms at 4k tokens, burst to 50rps during peak. Data residency: US-only.
- Risk/constraints: SOC2 evidence will be required before procurement; customer data must not be used for model training.

Next steps (ask):
1) VP/CTO alignment call to unblock procurement + exec sign-off — typically 30 minutes. We want to introduce Marissa (our Head of Solutions) and surface the SLA/resourcing ask.
2) Technical deep-dive (60 min) with your engineering lead to map integrations and test plan.

Proposed windows (PT) for the exec alignment call:
- Mon 29 Jun: 9:00–9:30, 11:30–12:00
- Tue 30 Jun: 14:00–14:30

If none of those work, tell me two slots that do. I’ve attached a one-pager and a mutual action plan draft for your review — nothing final, just to speed the procurement thread.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-sales-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@orbitai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VP/CTO alignment + proposed tech deep-dive slots

Thanks Alex — good summary. Samir is copied. A couple notes:

- VP (Marta) is traveling Mon morning but free Mon 11:00–11:30 PT. CTO (Anand) prefers afternoons but can do Tue 30 June 14:00–14:30 if Marta can make it.
- We also want the technical deep-dive to include our lead infra engineer (Priya) and our security SME (Michael) so they'll need the 60-minute slot.

Could you hold Tue 30 14:00–14:30 for the exec call? That aligns best with Anand and likely Marta if she can shift. I’ll confirm with Marta and Priya internally and aim to lock both sessions by EOD tomorrow.

— Jill
Jill Turner
Director of Product, OrbitAI

Perfect — thanks Jill. I’ve tentatively held Tue 30 Jun 14:00–14:30 PT for the exec alignment call on our calendar (placeholder invite will follow). Marissa — can you join this call to present the SLA/engagement plan?

Marissa: quick heads-up on likely asks from OrbitAI (from discovery):
- SLA wording around p95 token latency and maintenance windows
- Data residency and audit log retention options
- A proposed pilot: 3-week functional pilot with a single Small GPU pool and ramp plan

Karthik: circle back after the call with a proposed commercial outline we can review.

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated to show a three-week pilot option).

Thanks — Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Alex / Karthik — I can join Tue 30 at 14:00 PT. I’ll prepare a 10-minute exec deck that covers: SLA highlights, pilot scope, estimated monthly cost at pilot scale, and escalation path.

Two quick asks for the deck:
1) Can you confirm the nominal peak RPS numbers Samir mentioned in today's call (Alex)? I want to include target throughput with a buffer.
2) Karthik — please draft a one-slide commercial cadence: pilot pricing, potential volume discount bands, and the path to Dedicated capacity.

I’ll pull the slides from the sales one-pager and the MAP; will share a draft before EOD Mon so OrbitAI can see prior to the call.
